claim: NVDA: the board reinstated Huang as CEO on 22 Nov
quote: On November 22, 2026, the Board of Directors of NVIDIA Corporation reinstated Jen-Hsun Huang as NVIDIA's President, Chief Executive Officer and member of the Board of Directors, effective immediately.
Kress will continue to serve as NVIDIA's Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.
